questions.stem: A reaction profile shows reactants at 80 kJ, a peak at 200 kJ, and products at 50 kJ. What is the activation energy for the forward reaction?
questions.explanation: The activation energy for the forward reaction is the difference between the peak (transition state) and the reactants: Ea = 200 - 80 = 120 kJ. It is measured from the reactant energy level up to the highest point on the profile.
